title: persona
description: A type of viewer. A persona maps to one or more roles, whose lanes and steps are highlighted, and has an entry point where the viewer starts.

id.description: Unique id: lower-case letters and numbers joined by hyphens, e.g. partner-lead. Used in links.

summary.description: A short description, shown when viewers choose a persona.

roles.description: The ids of one or more roles this persona plays.

view.description: The kind of view to open.

id.description: The id of the workstream, process or role to open. Not needed for overview.

status.description: How this element differs from today.

today.description: How it works today, shown next to the future state.
